artists.biography: Todd Harry Rundgren (born June 22, 1948) is an American multi-instrumentalist, songwriter and record producer. Hailed in the early stage of his career as a new pop star, supported by the certified gold solo double LP Something/Anything? in 1972, his career has produced a diverse range of recordings as solo artist, and during the seventies and eighties with the band Utopia. He has also been prolific as a producer and engineer on the recorded work of other musicians.

Hailed in the early stage of his career as a new pop star, supported by the certified gold solo double LP Something/Anything? in 1972, his career has produced a diverse range of recordings as solo artist, and during the seventies and eighties with the band Utopia. He has also been prolific as a producer and engineer on the recorded work of other musicians.

perplexity.description:
Todd Rundgren's Faithful, released in 1976 on Bearsville Records, is a distinctive entry in his discography that blends rock and electronic elements with a conceptual twist. The album is divided into two thematic halves: the first side features faithful re-recordings of songs from 1966, showcasing Rundgren's versatility and technical prowess, while the second side presents original compositions inspired by the musical styles of that era. This approach highlights Rundgren's deep engagement with rock history and his ability to reinterpret and innovate within established genres.

Musically, Faithful spans art rock, power pop, and soft rock, with electronic textures woven throughout, reflecting Rundgren's growing interest in studio experimentation. The album stands out for its ambitious structure and genre-blending, marking a creative pivot after his earlier successes. Critically, the second side was praised by Robert Christgau as Rundgren's "clearest and most interesting set of songs since Something/Anything?". Commercially, the album peaked at number 54 on the Billboard album chart, with the single "Good Vibrations" reaching number 34 on the Billboard Pop Singles chart. Despite minimal promotion, Faithful remains a notable example of Rundgren's innovative spirit and genre-crossing artistry.
